name: Myo-Inositol
summary: Myo-inositol is a B-vitamin-like sugar alcohol used for PCOS, fertility, and insulin resistance. A high-profile 2025 JAMA trial (n=464) found 4 g/day during pregnancy did NOT reduce gestational diabetes/preeclampsia/preterm birth vs placebo (PMID 40920401), while a 2025 meta-analysis of 17 assisted-reproduction studies found increased clinical pregnancy rates (RR 1.64, PMID 40989082).
description: Canonical myo-inositol research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the pregnancy-indication boundary reflects the negative JAMA 2025 trial, myo-vs-d-chiro formulation ratios are documented, and fertility vs metabolic indications are separated, passing the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: insulin signaling; ovarian function; inositol phosphoglycan mediators
